correctness.rationale: The code exhausts all 2^12=4096 masks for O=K_{2,2,2}, finding 772 faces and facet dimensions 3,4,5. A 377-pair element-toggle matching is acyclic by a complete topological sort of all 771 nonempty faces and 2928 cover incidences; it yields 1 critical vertex, 6 critical 3-cells and 10 critical 4-cells. The explicitly printed 6x10 integral Morse boundary has rank 3 (fourth row equals minus first three, last rows zero) and a unit 3x3 minor (rows 1,2,3, columns 1,2,5), so its three nonzero Smith factors are 1. With no cells of dimensions 1,2 or >=5, attaching maps into a wedge of 3-spheres are completely classified by this degree matrix, proving the integral homotopy equivalence to 3 copies of S^3 and 7 copies of S^4. Independent direct full simplicial boundary calculations over F2 and F3 agree.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical regular octahedron, the first balanced complete tripartite graph, so its degree-two matching complex is motivated by the gap between complete-graph, bipartite, and other small graph-family classifications. The nonpure complex has facets in three dimensions and an exact mixed-dimensional wedge of 3 and 7 spheres in adjacent homological degrees, a substantive integral homotopy fact not forced by its face vector, Euler characteristic, ordinary matching complex, or the existing family theorems. This provides a natural benchmark and obstruction to naive equidimensionality expectations without asserting an infinite-family theorem.
